finding: Google publishes the release artifacts with no license file. The Google Antigravity Additional Terms of Service, read on 2026-11-21, name the Google Terms of Service, these Additional Terms, and the Google Privacy Policy as the governing documents and grant no explicit right to redistribute the CLI. On 2026-11-22 the maintainer settled that Flywheel install archives carry the unmodified, sha512-verified release ("Bundle; I permit it").
